name: braces
description: Local patch of braces 3.0.3. Nesting deeper than MAX_BRACE_DEPTH is returned literally so GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm cannot overflow the stack. Upstream has no release after 3.0.3; this version is 3.0.4 so a scanner that treats 3.0.3 as last_affected stops matching it.
author: Jon Schlinkert (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)
